“Canadian action to terminate the treaty would have little effect on the current dispute” (14 palavras: o corte fiel é do redator)

texto_aprovado: As a tariff fight between the two countries grew, CBC News asked whether ending this treaty could help Canada fight back. In March 2025, British Columbia's energy minister addressed the idea. "Canadian action to terminate the treaty would have little effect on the current dispute," he said. For one thing, leaving takes ten years' written notice, and nothing we've read says either side has given it.
